hero.title: The digital personnel file for your team
hero.subtitle: Employee data, shift planning, vacation and sick leave, time tracking and documents in one place – built for small and mid-sized businesses.

benefits.title: Everything for your HR admin. In one place.
benefits.subtitle: Ployo brings together personnel files, shift planning, vacation and sick leave, time tracking and file storage – clearly organised and accessible to your whole team.

personnelFile.title: Digital personnel file
personnelFile.description: Master data, contracts, payslips and documents for every person – sensitive data with its own access right.

shifts.title: Shift planning
shifts.description: Weekly view with shift templates – Ployo warns about understaffing, overlaps and rest periods that are too short.

absences.title: Vacation & sick leave
absences.description: Vacation requests with approval, allowances, sick notes with medical certificates and day-off requests.

files.title: File storage
files.description: Versions, expiry dates and sharing, PIN-protected folders and recovery of deleted files within 24 hours.

timeTracking.title: Time tracking
timeTracking.description: Time clock in the browser and the app, clocking in via QR code on site and easy corrections.

app.title: Your team always has Ployo with them.
app.subtitle: With the Ployo app, employees always have their shift plan, vacation balance and documents at hand – right on their smartphone.

points.requests: Submit vacation, day-off requests and sick notes

roles.title: Everyone sees exactly what they should.
roles.subtitle: Decide who may read or edit personnel files, shift plans, requests and documents – from management to temporary staff.

hr.label: HR lead
hr.description: Manages personnel files, contracts, absences and hours across the whole company.

payroll.label: Payroll
payroll.description: Manages payslips and sensitive data, has read access to everything else.

lead.label: Team lead
lead.description: Manages the shift plan and takes care of vacation and hours for their own team.

staff.label: Employee
staff.description: Sees their own data, submits requests and records working hours.

roles.footnote: Owners and admins have full access. You can create your own roles freely.

security.title: Your personnel data in safe hands.
security.subtitle: Personnel files are among a company's most sensitive data. That's why security at Ployo isn't an extra, it's the foundation.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: All data is transmitted via TLS. IBAN, tax ID and social security number are additionally stored encrypted (AES-256).

hosting.title: Hosted in Germany
hosting.description: The application and documents run in data centres in Frankfurt am Main.

processing.title: Data processing agreement
processing.description: Data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR – including with all service providers we use.

access.title: Role-based access
access.description: Only authorised people see sensitive personnel data – defined via roles, traceable via audit logs.

roadmap.title: Ployo grows with your requirements.
roadmap.subtitle: Ployo keeps getting better. This is how an idea from your daily work comes back to you as a new feature.

listen.title: Listen
listen.description: We collect feedback and requests from companies that use Ployo every day.

build.title: Build
build.description: This turns into new features and improvements for everyday work.

test.title: Test
test.description: Every change goes through automated tests before it goes live.

ship.title: Available immediately

pricing.title: The right plan for your team.
pricing.subtitle: Fixed monthly prices by team size – every plan includes all features. Try it free for 14 days and switch plans at any time.

professional.name: Professional
professional.description: For growing teams of up to 25 employees.

business.name: Business
business.description: For larger businesses of up to 50 employees.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Your question isn't listed? Write to us, we're happy to help.

trial.question: Can I try Ployo for free?
trial.answer: Yes. You can try Ployo free for 14 days. When you start, you enter your payment details – you're only charged after the trial and can cancel at any time before then.

audience.question: Which companies is Ployo suited for?
audience.answer: Ployo is built for small and mid-sized businesses – from a business with a handful of employees to companies with several locations and shift work.

app.question: Is there an app for my employees?
app.answer: Yes. With the Ployo app, your employees see their shift plan, submit vacation, day-off requests and sick notes, clock in via QR code and view their documents and payslips.

dataLocation.question: Where is my data stored?
dataLocation.answer: Ployo runs in data centres in Frankfurt am Main. Uploaded documents are stored in OVHcloud object storage, also in Frankfurt. Data processing agreements are in place with all service providers.

plans.question: Which features are included in which plan?
plans.answer: Every plan includes all features. The plans only differ in the number of employees: up to 5, up to 25 or up to 50 – higher limits on request.

cancel.question: Can I change or cancel my plan?
cancel.answer: Yes. You can change your plan at any time in the settings under “Billing”. There is no minimum term: you can cancel at any time effective at the end of the current billing period. You can export your data at any time.

cta.title: Ready for less paperwork?
cta.subtitle: Start with Ployo today and bring personnel files, shift planning and vacation together in one place.

footer.tagline: The digital personnel file for small and mid-sized businesses.
